mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_governance.application_catalog(application_id,owner_principal_id,entry_origin,created_by) VALUES(#{app.applicationId},#{app.ownerPrincipalId},#{app.entryOrigin},#{operator}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT FROM auth_governance.application_catalog WHERE application_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT application_id,version,content_hash,manifest_json FROM auth_governance.application_manifest WHERE application_id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_governance.application_catalog SET manifest_version=#{version} WHERE application_id=#{id} AND manifest_version=#{previous}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM auth_governance.capability_state WHERE application_id=#{id} AND capability=#{cap} AND disabled)
